newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Fresh funds help Dhaka stocks yield 7.02 pct.
newsitem.headline: Fresh funds help Dhaka stocks yield 7.02 pct.

text.p: Fresh flow of funds by mostly retail investors propelled the Dhaka stocks to a 7.02 percent gain at close on Monday, brokers said.

The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) benchmark index rose 235.58 points or 7.02 percent at 3,587.68 on a record turnover at 558.9 million taka. Of the 130 traded issues, 114 rose, 14 lost and two unchanged. "We are puzzled by the rush of funds into the market. People just want shares no matter what those are," said broker Moshtaque Ahmed.
Bangladesh Tobacco Co gained 42 taka to 462 and Shine Pukur Holdings rose 33.68 to 374.68.
